I have farmed this land for over forty years and I own it, so I want to keep the soil strong for my children. I will apply two bags of NPK fertilizer per hectare because my cousin got bigger yams with it last season, and I will spread goat manure since I have some from my animals. I will plant my own yam setts that I kept from last harvest, and I will not waste money on chemicals for root crops when cash is tight. My wife and children will work with me on this plot, and I will hire about twelve days of labor to help with the heavy mounding and harvesting because at 63 my back is not what it used to be.
